# Stroomlijnen Knowledge Base
> docs.stroomlijnen.nl

Stroomlijnen B.V. is a Dutch CPO (Charge Point Operator) and eMSP (e-Mobility Service Provider) specializing in electric truck charging at theaters and logistics sites in the Netherlands. We operate our own OCPP 2.0.1 stack, ISO 15118 PKI infrastructure, and NL*STM eMSP identity.

## Getting Started
- [What is Stroomlijnen?](https://docs.stroomlijnen.nl/docs/getting-started/intro) — Introduction to our services, how fleet charging works
- [Your First Charging Session](https://docs.stroomlijnen.nl/docs/getting-started/first-session) — Step-by-step guide for drivers and fleet managers
- [RFID Cards](https://docs.stroomlijnen.nl/docs/getting-started/rfid-cards) — Ordering, activating, and managing charging cards

## Plug & Charge (ISO 15118)
- [What is Plug & Charge?](https://docs.stroomlijnen.nl/docs/plug-and-charge/what-is-pnc) — Plain English explanation of automatic EV authentication
- [How Plug & Charge Works](https://docs.stroomlijnen.nl/docs/plug-and-charge/how-it-works) — ISO 15118, certificates, PKI trust chain with diagrams
- [Compatible Vehicles](https://docs.stroomlijnen.nl/docs/plug-and-charge/compatible-vehicles) — Which electric trucks and cars support Plug & Charge
- [Setup Guide](https://docs.stroomlijnen.nl/docs/plug-and-charge/setup-guide) — How to enable Plug & Charge via the fleet portal
- [Volvo Trucks Guide](https://docs.stroomlijnen.nl/docs/plug-and-charge/brand-guides/volvo-trucks) — FH/FM/FE Electric via Volvo Connect
- [DAF Trucks Guide](https://docs.stroomlijnen.nl/docs/plug-and-charge/brand-guides/daf) — XD/XF Electric via DAF Connect
- [Mercedes-Benz Trucks Guide](https://docs.stroomlijnen.nl/docs/plug-and-charge/brand-guides/mercedes-trucks) — eActros via Fleetboard
- [Scania Guide](https://docs.stroomlijnen.nl/docs/plug-and-charge/brand-guides/scania) — BEV series via Scania Fleet Management
- [MAN Guide](https://docs.stroomlijnen.nl/docs/plug-and-charge/brand-guides/man) — eTruck via MAN RIO
- [Other Trucks & Vans](https://docs.stroomlijnen.nl/docs/plug-and-charge/brand-guides/other-trucks) — Renault, Ford, VW, IVECO
- [Passenger Cars](https://docs.stroomlijnen.nl/docs/plug-and-charge/brand-guides/passenger-cars) — BMW, Hyundai, VW, Mercedes, Volvo Cars, Polestar
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.stroomlijnen.nl/docs/plug-and-charge/troubleshooting) — Common issues and error codes
